"""RoboPaint record: camera-calibrated pen motions; no resets or hidden state."""
import sys, json, os, time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
ROOT='/app/output'
r=Robot()
statefile=ROOT+'/motion_state.json'
state=json.load(open(statefile)) if os.path.exists(statefile) else {'n':0}
def obs(cameras=['canvas_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],depth=False):
 o=r.get_obs(cameras=cameras,depth=depth)
 return o

def submit(P,note='',cameras=['practice_cam'],video='none'):
 state['n']+=1;n=state['n']
 np.save(f'{ROOT}/commands_{n:03d}.npy',np.array(P))
 json.dump(state,open(statefile,'w'))
 o=r.submit('ee_pose',P,dt=.05,cameras=cameras,video=video,video_fps=5,note=note)
 o.save(f'{ROOT}/run_{n:03d}')
 for k,v in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(v).save(f'{ROOT}/latest_{k}.png')
 state['pose']=list(np.array(P)[-1]);json.dump(state,open(statefile,'w'))
 print(n,note,'steps',o.meta.get('control_steps_chunk'),'tip',o.group('tcp_pose',now=True).round(6).tolist(),'plan',str(o.meta.get('plan'))[:250],flush=True)
 return o

def quat(deg=35):
 a=np.deg2rad(deg)/2
 return np.array([0,np.cos(a),np.sin(a),0])

def move(pose,seconds=1,note='move',cameras=['practice_cam']):
 start=np.array(state.get('pose',obs(cameras=[]).group('tcp_pose',now=True)))
 pose=np.array(pose);N=max(2,int(round(seconds*20)))
 rs=Rotation.from_quat(np.array([start[3:],pose[3:]])[:,[1,2,3,0]])
 from scipy.spatial.transform import Slerp
 t=np.linspace(0,1,N+1)[1:]; qs=Slerp([0,1],rs)(t).as_quat()[:,[3,0,1,2]]
 P=np.c_[start[:3]+(pose[:3]-start[:3])*t[:,None],qs]
 for i in range(0,N,180):out=submit(P[i:i+180],note,cameras)
 return out

def at(x,y,z,angle=35):return [x,y,z,*quat(angle)]
def hold(seconds=.5,cameras=['practice_cam']):return submit([state['pose']]*int(seconds*20),'settle',cameras)

def dip():
 move(at(-.10,.153,.10,0),3,'above ink', ['scene_cam'])
 move(at(-.10,.153,.025,0),2,'dip into ink',['scene_cam'])
 hold(.5,['scene_cam'])
 move(at(-.10,.153,.08,0),2,'lift from ink',['scene_cam'])
 move(at(-.065,-.17,.065),4,'above practice')
 hold(.5)

def practice():
 move(at(-.055,-.17,.022),1,'approach practice')
 move(at(-.055,-.17,.0192),.7,'contact practice')
 hold(.5)
 move(at(-.075,-.168,.0192),4,'practice downstroke')
 hold(.5)
 move(at(-.075,-.168,.035),1,'lift practice')
 move(at(-.19,-.20,.07),2,'clear practice view')
 o=obs(['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],True);o.save(ROOT+'/after_practice')
 for k,v in o.last.items():Image.fromarray(v).save(ROOT+'/clear_'+k+'.png')

if __name__=='__main__':
 if sys.argv[1]=='dip':dip()
 elif sys.argv[1]=='practice':practice()
